title: Approximants de Padé et mesures effectives d'irrationalité
notes: Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1985–86, Progress in Mathematics 71, Birkhäuser, 1987, pp. 155–164. The Proposition on p. 160, equation (7), bounds the absolute value at height H=max(|u1|,|u2|). Paper A substitutes (u0,u1,u2)=(0,-L,o), H=L, and retains the conservative constant 915. The transcendence estimate is an external theorem, not a Lean proof.
